newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Blue chips push the Mauritius bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips push the Mauritius bourse index down.

text.p: Falling prices of blue chips brought forced the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index, Semdex, down 0.89 points to 380.97 on Friday, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 4.79 million rupees on 118,722 shares from 5.75 million rupees on 160,810 shares on Wednesday.
Hotel-based Sun Resorts lost 80 cents to 49.20 rupees on 800 shares, New Mauritius Hotels fell 30 cents to 37.30 on 1,725 shares and Grand Baie Hotel gained 90 cents to 50 on 1,250 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was 80 cents lower to 36.50 rupees on 2,780 shares.
In the commerce sector, conglomerate Rogers lost a rupee to 95 rupees on 2,552 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd was unchanged at 15.80 rupees on 1,220 shares.
Sugar stock Mon Tresor Mon Desert eased 50 cents to 39.00 rupees on 29,851 shares and Mon Desert Alma was 1.50 rupee down at 80.50 rupees on 450 shares.
State Bank of Mauritius gained 10 cents to 12.40 rupees on 26,300 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 90 rupees on 21,671 shares.
